descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S24 Retention edges for tasks closed or left open by Save & Extract

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 Task retention and clock: Hospital completed tasks clear at 16 h; Hospital open tasks clear 36 h after the chart was last processed; … (UAT 3.6; UAT 3.8)
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident after the UAT script: two completed and two open tasks each, back-dated by the aging helper

When Read the task lists at each edge

Then Hospital: completed tasks shown at 15 h, gone at 17 h; open tasks on a chart last processed 35 h ago shown, 37 h gone. Nursing Home: open tasks still shown at 37 h and after two further visits; completed tasks at 15 h / 17 h recorded for Q12

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 windows ±1 h; the two-week task in Hospital is Q10. On main there is no open-task window for Hospital (convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:220-227 clears done tasks only, and no cron clears tasks), so the 37 h open-task edge is expected to fail. Nursing Home completed tasks: main clears them at 16 h (SNF_RETENTION.doneTask); recorded, not judged, until Q12 says which window applies

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from failed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92592 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress

Open tasks on a Hospital chart that has not been processed for 37 hours are still listed, past the 36-hour window.

Evidence: allure-results/abae9225…: 7/8 pass. Hospital open tasks on a chart last processed 37 h ago are still shown: main has no Hospital open-task window (TFA-94699 in progress; TC-22 Q10 predicts this fail). Same root as the open-task cells in TC-20/S11 and TC-21/S17. NH completed-task retention is recorded only (Q12).

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-22/S24

Retention edges for tasks closed or left open by Save & Extract

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

No model involved. Spec ext-tc22-s24-retention.spec.ts (re-run of the manual-lane spec): back-dated stamps written through rounding:add / snf:add, then applyLifecycle as on page load, against the server clock. Judged 7/8: Hospital completed tasks shown at 15 h and gone at 17 h (both charts), Hospital open tasks at 35 h shown, Nursing Home open tasks at 37 h and after two further visits shown; fails: Hospital open tasks on a chart processed 37 h ago still shown (UAT 3.6 open tasks 36 h) — known B19 (TFA-94699, in progress). Recorded (Q12): Nursing Home completed task at 15 h present, at 17 h gone.

Product issue: Hospital: open tasks on a chart nobody has processed for 37 h are still shown (UAT 3.6 says 36 h).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Reading the task lists at the 15 / 17 h and 35 / 37 h edges needs the aging helper (back-dated doneAt / processed stamps through a test-only internal mutation, called with the local stack's admin key) or a server-clock shift; dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot be moved, so this stay…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local manual] failed · product (manual/results.json) — manual: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)) 7/8 judged cells pass (3 of them not discriminating on main), 2 recorded. Fail: Hospital: open tasks on a chart last processed 37 h ago gone (3.6 open tasks 36 h) [U13]. Recorded: Nursing Home: completed task done 15 h ago (Q12) = "present" | Nursing Home: completed task done 17 h ago (Q12) = "absent". Product…
